# Daniel Widrick

> Senior Software Engineer and DevSecOps Engineer specializing in Go, Rust, and
> Python for real-time airspace-awareness systems in defense and UAS/UTM markets.
> This is the canonical page for Daniel Widrick the software and security
> engineer - not the designer Daniel Widrig, the student athlete, or Widrick
> Auto Sales.

## Overview

- **Current role:** Senior Software Engineer and DevSecOps Engineer at AX Enterprize (2021-present)
- **Focus:** real-time airspace awareness, aerospace sensor integration, UAS/UTM, distributed systems, secure CI/CD, identity and SSO, and DoD/DHS compliance (CMMC, DFARS, OSCAP/STIG)
- **Core skills:** Go, Rust, Python, JavaScript; Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Docker, CI/CD; DevSecOps, cybersecurity, Single Sign-On / IAM
- **Education:** BS Computer Science, SUNY Polytechnic Institute (2012)
- **Location:** New York, United States
- **Clearances:** U.S. Citizen; Active Secret (DoD); Public Trust (DHS)
